title: Residency Length Step on the Preferred Employer Rate
content:
The preferred employer rate of an Apartment Home Lease is raised by a tenure step for the full calendar months in possession, counted from the move-in date to the same day number of a later month: 48 months or more raise it by 0.005, 36 to 47 months raise it by 0.0025, and fewer leave it unchanged.

| Full calendar months in possession on the handling date | Tenure step added to the preferred employer rate |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 0.005 (0.5%) |
| 36 to 47 | 0.0025 (0.25%) |
| 35 or fewer | nothing |

**Counting.** A month is complete on the same day number of a later month as the move-in date. The move-in date is read from the lease record.

**Effect.** The step raises the preferred employer rate itself; the raised rate is applied to the period's base rent line.

**Boundary dates (hypothetical move-in on 10 April 2022).**

| Handling date | Full calendar months | Tenure step |
|---|---|---|
| 9 April 2025 | 35 | nothing |
| 10 April 2025 | 36 | 0.0025 |
| 9 April 2026 | 47 | 0.0025 |
| 10 April 2026 | 48 | 0.005 |
